description: This file defines a configuration class for transforming and interacting with Perplexity's chat API, including methods for customizing request parameters, processing responses, extracting citation and search query information, and annotating responses with citation metadata. It extends capabilities from OpenAI's configuration, adapting them specifically for Perplexity's API.

classes.name: PerplexityChatConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Perplexity-specific chat API interactions, extending OpenAIGPTConfig to support Perplexity's API and response processing peculiarities.

methods.name: Optional[str] custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Property returning the custom LLM provider name, set to 'perplexity'.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Retrieves API base URL and API key, defaulting to Perplexity-specific secrets if not provided.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters, adding reasoning and web search options if the model supports those features.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms the raw HTTP response into a ModelResponse object, including extraction of usage data, citations, and search queries; also annotates messages with citation info.

methods.name: None _enhance_usage_with_perplexity_fields( self, model_response: ModelResponse, raw_response_json: dict )
methods.description: Enhances the ModelResponse's usage object with citation token counts and web search request counts based on the Perplexity response JSON.

methods.name: None _add_citations_as_annotations( self, model_response: ModelResponse, raw_response_json: dict )
methods.description: Adds citation and search result annotations to the message content based on detected citation markers and response data.
